name: NEXIMMUNE INC.  DL-,0001
summary: NexImmune, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing a new approach to immunotherapy by directing the body's immune system to fight cancer. Their technology platform, called AIM (Artificial Immune Modulation), uses artificial immune cells to educate and redirect T cells to attack tumor cells. The company is headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland.
